sections.heading: End-to-end security, from code to AI
sections.body:
End-to-end security, from code to AI: our own products plus specialist services. Connect offensive testing, cloud security and GRC with architecture review, security operations and incident response.

Our services bring together controls, IAM and regulation, staff education and phishing drills, and machine learning for security and risk. Linkfields IP adds AI-powered external exposure validation, code and supply-chain analysis, and a gateway for AI guardrails, cost and tracing.

sections.heading: Specialist services and LINKFIELDS IP
sections.body: Explore our services and the Linkfields products that bring reusable software IP into enterprise delivery.
